SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001784
DOCKET NO. F00992425
PLAINTIFF – ABS LOAN TRUST VI
DEFENDANTS- ANNA LEE, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday The 7th Day of October 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the MUNICIPALITY OF PRINCETON, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 183 FKA 1.01 QUAL C0183 BLOCK 96.28
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
202 BENTLY DRIVE PRINCETON, NJ 08540
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
The property to be sold is located in the TOWNSHIP of SOUTH BRUNSWICK in the County of MIDDLESEX and State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as 202 BENTLY DRIVE, PRINCETON, NJ 08540
Tax LOT 183 FKA 1.01 QUAL C0183 BLOCK 96.28
Dimensions of Lot: Together with An Undivided .50505 Percent Interest in The Common Elements of The Woods at Princeton Walk Condo. Assoc. Inc. Condo.
Nearest Cross Street: N Hampton Circle
Estimated upset bid amount: $294,000.00, plus any additional sums as ordered by the court.
Occupancy Status: Owner Occupied.
THE SHERIFF HEREBY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO ADJOURN THIS SALE WITHOUT FURTHER NOTICE THROUGH PUBLICATION.

PROSPECTIVE PURCHASERS ARE ON NOTICE THAT ANY PURCHASE IS SUBJECT TO A PRIOR MORTGAGE TO HSBC MORTGAGE CORPORATION IN THE ORIGINAL AMOUNT OF $219,000.00 RECORDED ON 05/26/2004 IN BK 9675 AT PG 559 WITH THE MERCER COUNTY CLERK. THE MORTGAGE WAS THEN ASSIGNED TO MORTGAGE ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION SYSTEMS, INC. AS NOMINEE FOR HSBC BANK USA, NA BY ASSIGNMENT RECORDED 8/5/2011 RECORDED IN BK 1058 PG 9 WITH THE MERCER COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER. THE MORTGAGE WAS THEN ASSIGNED TO HSBC BANK USA, NA BY ASSIGNMENT RECORDED ON 4/5/2012 IN BK 1073 PG 365 WITH THE MERCER COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER. THE MORTGAGE WAS THEN ASSIGNED TO NATIONSTAR MORTGAGE LLC BY ASSIGNMENT RECORDED 1/26/2017 IN BK 1200 PG 445 WITH THE MERCER COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER. THE MORTGAGE WAS THEN MODIFIED BY LOAN MODIFICATION AGREEMENT DATED 4/19/2017 RECORDED 5/3/2017 WHEREIN THE UNPAID PRINCIPAL BALANCE WAS MODIFIED TO $182,937.37. SAID AGREEMENT WAS RECORDED IN BK 249 PG 510 WITH THE MERCER COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER. THE MORTGAGE WAS THEN ASSIGNED TO SPECIALIZED LOAN SERVICING LLC BY ASSIGMENT RECORDED ON 2/22/2018 IN BK 17090 PG 51 WITH MERCER COUNTY CLERK/REGISTER. PROSPECTIVE PURCHASER ARE ON NOTICE THAT THE WOODS AT PRINCETON WALK CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION INC. MAY BE ENTITLED TO LIMITED PRIORITY PURSUANT TO STATUTE.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $268,493.51 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: August 20, 2026
ROBERTSON, ANSCHUTZ, SCHNEID, CRANE & PARTNERS, PLLC
130 CLINTON ROAD STE 202
FAIRFIELD, NJ 07004
(973) 575-0707
